Frequently asked questions

Quick answers for people searching Odoo Dynamic Dashboard and Odoo Dashboard Builder.

What is Odoo Dynamic Dashboard with AI?

It is a Dashboard Builder for Odoo 19 that creates interactive Dynamic Dashboards with AI assistance, 50+ chart types, KPIs, SQL, multi-source data, filters, sharing, and TV Mode.

Does it work on Odoo Community and Enterprise?

Yes — Community, Enterprise (on-premise), and Odoo.sh. Odoo Online (SaaS) does not allow third-party apps.

Can I build a Sales or CRM Dashboard?

Yes. Ready-made and custom boards cover Sales, CRM, Inventory, Accounting, Purchase, HR, Project, and more.

Is AI required?

No. Charts, SQL, Visual Query Builder, KPIs, filters, TV Mode, and sharing work without AI. AI is optional when you add your own provider key.
